system.description: The Ferrus Prime is exactly what it says it is: a prime assault rifle and no doubt! A slightly upscaled version of the Major, in that it is a bullpup layout with its four power clips fitting into the sides of the weapon, the Prime is unmistakeable as anything but an assault rifle. If you’re fond of the Ares Alpha, then I guarantee you’ll like the Ferrus Prime! It comes with an underbarrel weapon mount as standard, allowing you to choose which option best fits your style or your mission. I should point out that while the penetrators for the Prime are the same 4 millimeter caliber as the Minor and Major, they are over twice as long to allow for the greater range and stopping power of a rifle-type weapon. Ferrus Maximus The Ferrus Maximus is a sniper rifle, or anti-material rifle if you prefer. Using the same long penetrators as the Prime, the Maximus does away with the bullpup configuration for a more conventional rifle layout. The oddity with the Maximus is that the power clips do not fit flush, with all six of them sticking out the side of the rifle allowing for easy access without breaking your grip and coming off the rifle. This allows the Maximus to be operated more easily by a single shooter in a hide, thus maximizing the benefits of the range, power, and accuracy of this weapon. The Maximus is not a subtle weapon by any means, thanks to the extended barrel, rigid stock, and bipod. The stock also has a monopod to allow for maximum comfort for long stretches on the gun in a sniper’s hide.
